description: This file defines the Backup controller class for the OpenCart admin system, handling backup operations such as generating backup tasks for database tables and performing the actual backup write process.

classes.name: Backup
classes.description: Controller class for managing database backup tasks within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of backup tasks for specified database tables based on user input and schedules their execution.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Performs the actual process of backing up a specific database table, generating SQL insert statements, and saving them to a backup file.
